why: B142 (SSPN-339), C++. Two test programs, `t1/a.cpp` and `t2/a.cpp`, each define their own `struct Fixture` and `run()`. One merged `cpp:Fixture` and `cpp:run` gave both programs one node, with t1's provenance, so the clang pass refused t2's true call `run -> Fixture::go` as a caller mismatch. Labelled from the source: two programs, each calling its own `go`. Needs the `clang` extra for the member call (as CI runs).
